process_read.scope: Read local process metadata through Win32_Process and Get-Process for audit, plan construction, identity preconditions, and post-action verification.
process_read.reason: Complete local process identity and descendant evidence is required to prevent cleanup from affecting unaudited or replaced processes.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must enforce local process-read access.
target_enforcement.claude: Permission metadata only; the host must enforce local process-read access.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust does not grant process access; the host must enforce it.

subprocess.scope: Invoke local Windows tasklist for structured read-only app association and taskkill only for a user-authorized, prevalidated process-tree plan.
subprocess.reason: Windows built-in commands provide the required app association and tree termination behavior while deterministic tests replace both actions with shims.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must enforce subprocess authorization.
target_enforcement.claude: Permission metadata only; the host must enforce subprocess authorization.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust does not grant subprocess access; the host must enforce it.

process_termination.scope: Terminate only PIDs in the displayed unblocked cleanup plan after explicit user authorization and a successful immediate identity and closure recheck.
process_termination.reason: Termination is the requested capability, but it is irreversible and therefore limited by audit-first planning, narrow profiles, preconditions, and post-action verification.

target_enforcement.openai: Contract metadata; the host must require authorization for process termination.
target_enforcement.claude: Contract metadata; the host must require authorization for process termination.
target_enforcement.generic: Downstream hosts must provide equivalent explicit authorization and fail-closed checks.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust alone is insufficient; explicit process-termination permission is required.

file_write.scope: Write only caller-selected local JSON or Markdown audit report paths supplied through ExportJson or ExportMarkdown.
file_write.reason: Optional local reports make the reviewed plan auditable; no default path is written and report files contain only local process evidence.

target_enforcement.openai: Permission metadata only; the host must enforce destination scope.
target_enforcement.claude: Permission metadata only; the host must enforce destination scope.
target_enforcement.generic: Permission metadata for downstream host enforcement.
target_enforcement.vscode: The host must enforce workspace and destination write boundaries.

registry_read.scope: No registry read is required by version 2.0 runtime behavior.
registry_read.reason: The unsupported Phone Link registry path was removed, so no registry state is used to select, execute, or verify cleanup.

target_enforcement.openai: Deny registry access for this skill.
target_enforcement.claude: Deny registry access for this skill.
target_enforcement.generic: Downstream hosts should deny registry access.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust does not authorize registry access.

registry_write.scope: Version 2.0 must not write HKCU or any other registry location; the deprecated flag fails before enumeration.
registry_write.reason: No current authoritative and reversible Windows contract was found for the former Phone Link registry values, so mutation is fail-closed.

target_enforcement.openai: Deny registry writes for this skill.
target_enforcement.claude: Deny registry writes for this skill.
target_enforcement.generic: Downstream hosts should deny registry writes.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust does not authorize registry writes.
